articles.title: AI Evolution: Merchants of Compute
articles.content:
**《AI进化》编辑手记**：本系列将于东部时间中午12点推出，关注AI领域的突破性进展和行业宏观发展，旨在为投资者、高管、AI爱好者和风险投资人提供简洁明了的关键动态。文章节奏可能不固定，但会精选行业里程碑事件，便于快速阅读或浏览。

---

**午安，**

科技巨头的惊人资本支出催生了专注于AI基础设施的新型云计算服务商，这些公司以GPU即服务（GPU-as-a-Service）为核心业务模式，从最底层的计算资源入手。其中资金最雄厚、客户最庞大的新型云计算（Neo Clouds）将成为行业中最具影响力的企业。

许多创新能力强且资金充足的Neo Clouds尚未上市。2026年9月17日，**Crusoe**宣布完成39亿美元F轮融资，成为私有资本支持最强的Neo Cloud之一，使其能够借助大量债务资金加速扩张。与**CoreWeave**和**Nebius**这样的行业领头羊相比，Crusoe和**Nscale**等公司正在迅速追赶。

Crusoe在垂直整合方面表现突出，不依赖电网基础设施，并成功减少了对OpenAI的依赖，现已为微软、Meta、Oracle和Jane Street等企业提供服务。**彼得·蒂尔的Founders Fund**以及多个全球主权财富基金和科技巨头均对其进行了投资，进一步巩固了其在行业中的地位。
articles.summary:
Editor’s Note: AI Evolution is a new series I’m doing that goes out at 12:00 PM Eastern Time, with a focus on AI related breakthroughs and macro developments that are key to the industry’s future. I’m not sure of the cadence rate of these articles yet but they are meant to be short and easy to read/skim about pivotal can’t miss moments in AI development and AI history useful for a wide range of readers including investors, executives, AI news fanatics and venture capitalists.

Good Afternoon,

The incredible Capex by BigTech have created massive Neo Clouds that specialize in AI Infrastructure with GPU-as-a-Service business models at the most physical level of compute. The biggest of these Neo Clouds with the top financing and biggest customers are going to become massively powerful companies.

Many of the more innovative and well funded Neo Clouds have yet to go public. On September 17th, 2026 Crusoe confirmed it raised a $3.9 Billion Series F round. Companies like Crusoe and Nscale yet to go public have a lot of momentum to catch up larger Neo Clouds like CoreWeave and Nebius.

Crusoe is now the most backed private neocloud in terms of equity, enabling it to get significant debt for expansion. They are a vertically integrated company independent from grid readiness that has overcome early reliance in customer concentration with OpenAI, now serving Microsoft, Meta, Oracle and Jane Street. They are backed not just by Peter Thiel’s Founders Fund but by several of the world’s top Sovereign Wealth Funds and major Tech corporations.
